what.body: GybeLock lets you drop windsurfing videos into a folder on your computer, automatically uploads and processes them in the background, and lets you review them later in a smooth player.
what.bodyMuted: Just add MP4s to your folder — GybeLock handles the rest.
what.footageNote: Designed for shore-shot, long-zoom footage — Not designed for GoPro or action-cam POV videos.
what.title: What GybeLock does

watchFolder.body: Choose a folder on your computer where your windsurfing videos live. GybeLock keeps an eye on this folder for new videos and automatically processes any new MP4s you add.
watchFolder.nextDisabledTooltip: Select a Video Folder to continue.
watchFolder.permissions: Your browser will ask for permission to access this folder so GybeLock can keep processing your videos.
watchFolder.safety: Your files are never changed, moved, or modified. GybeLock only reads this folder.
watchFolder.uploadNotice: When you add videos, GybeLock securely uploads them to our servers for stabilization and analysis. Your original files are never modified.
watchFolder.tip: Tip: It’s often easiest to create a new empty folder (for example “Windsurf Videos”) and use that.
watchFolder.title: Choose a Video Folder

addVideos.body: Drag MP4 videos into this folder (or copy them there).
addVideos.muted: Videos appear here automatically as they are processed.
addVideos.processingTime: Most videos take 1–3 minutes to process.
addVideos.subfolders: Tip: Subfolders are supported — GybeLock mirrors your folder structure exactly.
addVideos.title: Add videos

reviewRiding.focused: Hover a rider and click to switch to Focused view, where that rider stays centered and stable.
reviewRiding.overview: Videos open in Overview mode, where the scene is stabilized and all riders stay visible.
reviewRiding.tip: Tip: Click anywhere or press Esc to return to Overview mode.
reviewRiding.title: Review your riding

cannotOpen.answer: Only jobs with status “succeeded” can be opened. If it’s processing, wait a moment and refresh.
cannotOpen.question: Why can’t I open a video yet?

deleteAccount.answer: Open the Analyzer, click Settings, then click Delete account.
deleteAccount.question: How do I delete my account?

fileNotFound.answer: The player opens videos from your local video folder. If the file can’t be located, select the correct folder again (Video Folder → Change folder) and make sure the video still exists in that folder.
fileNotFound.question: Why does the player say “VIDEO FILE NOT FOUND”?

formats.answer: MP4 is recommended. If you encounter issues, try re-exporting to H.264 MP4.
formats.question: What formats are supported?

ingressFolder.answer: It’s a folder on your computer that GybeLock keeps an eye on for new videos. When you drop a new video in it, GybeLock will automatically upload it for processing.
ingressFolder.question: What is the local video folder?

movedVideo.answer: If the moved/renamed file can’t be found, the player may show VIDEO FILE NOT FOUND. Put the video back into the local video folder (or expected subfolder) and make sure the correct local video folder is selected.
movedVideo.question: I moved or renamed a video. What should I do?

processedVideos.answer: They appear in the Analyzer grid as soon as a job is finished. Click a tile to open the player.
processedVideos.question: Where do processed videos appear?

shortcuts.answer: In the Analyzer / Player, click Shortcuts to open the keyboard shortcuts modal.
shortcuts.question: How do I see all keyboard controls?

supportedFootage.answer: GybeLock is designed for shore / beach-shot videos (tele/zoom from land). MP4 is recommended. GoPro/action-cam POV footage is not supported / not the intended use case.
supportedFootage.question: What footage is supported?

uploadSkipped.answer: GybeLock deduplicates videos by checksum. If that exact video was already uploaded/processed, it may be skipped.
uploadSkipped.question: Why was my upload skipped?

uploadsPaused.answer: Open Video Folder and check the error message. If uploads paused after a failure, use Retry failed. If you see a beta feedback request message, please reach out to us.
uploadsPaused.question: Uploads are paused / stuck. What can I do?

videoTooLong.answer: There is a maximum supported video length. If your upload fails with “Video too long”, split the recording into shorter clips and upload those.
videoTooLong.question: Why does upload say “Video too long”?

whatDoes.answer: GybeLock helps you review beach-shot windsurf footage (shore camera, long zoom) by stabilizing the footage, detecting/tracking riders, and letting you click a rider to get a smooth, focused view for review.
whatDoes.question: What is GybeLock supposed to do?
